notes.title: Reconnoitre Demo Update 1.0.1.10 is live
notes.content:
Hi scouts,

A small update to the demo before I break for the holidays!

With the release date getting closer the list of things to do is thankfully getting shorter! Keep an eye out for further updates; I plan to update the demo with more content from the full release as it's ready.

Your support is greatly appreciated (and makes the game that much better!), so please send feedback, wishlist/share, and check the NotGood website for other ways to get involved!

Changes:

Added new locations to explore

 Caves - Find and help survivors!
 Shrines - Find new glyphs!
 Markets - Buy things!
 Towers - Search for answers!

Added a new quest line

 Research the cause of the darkness!

Enabled glyph upgrading

 Power up your loadout!

Plus the usual items you'd expect from an update:

 More balancing changes
 	Expanded tutorial content
 	Bug fixes


Thanks for exploring the world of Reconnoitre!
